_comment: Edit site chrome in partials/ and page markup in templates/ (not root HTML). Run npm run build to expand @include into index.html and blog/**, then sync placeholders from siteOrigin/calBookingUrl. Commit generated root HTML after build+sync for GitHub Pages (workflow A). llms.txt, robots.txt, sitemap.xml: run npm run sync after editing placeholders there. Global CSS: css/shared.css (blog + tokens); css/home.css (landing only).
